source: Recorded on the maintainer's machine (real-CLI lane, 17 §5.5) through scripts/fixtures/record.mjs and scrub.mjs, against the person's own user-installed @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp 0.93.0 (Apache-2.0, npm global install; never bundled or shipped by DwarfAI, OQ-52) with CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE pinned to the person's Claude Code 2.1.302, started as node <adapter entry> with shell: false. The recorder framed what ClaudeAcpDriver sends (initialize with elicitation.form only, session/new and session/load {cwd, mcpServers: []}, session/prompt, session/cancel, session/close; asks answered allow_once, reject_once or cancelled). One difference, visible in each -sent stream: session/new and session/load also carried _meta.claudeCode.options {settingSources: [], strictMcpConfig: true, allowDangerouslySkipPermissions: false}, so the maintainer's own settings, hooks, plugins and MCP servers stayed out of the recording and no auto-approving mode could start; the frame count and order equal the driver's. Cases no recording covers stay in ../2.1.x-synthetic/.

capabilities.promptUsage: per turn: each session/prompt response's usage counts that turn only

thirdParty.changes: copied byte for byte (LF); the -with-extra and CRLF variants are DwarfAI additions
thirdParty.note: A Claude session transcript the adapter replays on session/load (a spend-limit error turn), synthetic upstream; it is the adapter's on-disk input, not ACP traffic, so no expected file replays it through the driver. Kept as the reference shape for usage.rateLimits, which stays false until a recording shows _meta["_claude/rateLimit"].
